patch_assessment: The earlier patch (if (!message.id) message.id = newMsgKey;) was proven active in the running browser, but was completely insufficient. It failed because mediaData instance properties (__x_id, parent, collection) leaked via ...mediaOptions, and mediaData.id ('1'/'2') is truthy so !message.id was false. Furthermore, message.__x_id crashed WhatsApp Web's internal memoization getter.
